title: Understanding the Task
text: You need to add a column $$`has_{feat}`$$ to the DataFrame $$`song_{sample}`$$. This column should indicate whether the artist string contains the substring "feat."

title: Using String Methods
text: Consider using the `str.contains()` method to check if the artist string contains "feat.".

title: Converting Boolean to Integer
text: The `str.contains()` method returns a boolean value. You can convert this to an integer using `astype(int)`.

title: Constructing the Expression
text: Write the expression to create the $$`has_{feat}`$$ column using `str.contains()` and `astype(int)`.
